Original two-tone stereo regression data generated by
tools/generate-audio-fixtures.py: 0.1 seconds, 44.1 kHz, left 440 Hz, right 660 Hz.
These contain no recordings or music from third parties. They are covered by
the repository's BSD 3-Clause license. Generated encoder output is test data;
the generating Python tools are not dependencies of the application or tests.

FLAC is lossless PCM16. Ogg Vorbis and MP3 tests allow encoder delay and loss,
but check native channel/rate metadata, finite nonzero PCM and channel mixing.
